verdict.rationale: Smithery once offered headless-capable surfaces: a CLI (`smithery tool call`), a REST interface, and scoped service tokens. None of these were documented for CI use, and all were shut down on October 31, 2026. The vendor states that the Smithery API, accounts and API keys, CLI and SDKs stopped working, leaving only a non-proxied public registry. With no working programmatic or CLI surface, there is no current evidence the product can run headlessly or in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
